about: Where RE3MR's render (hand-modelled from screenshots) drifts from the game's own positions, in drawing units (about 1 m). fix = game minus render, blended smoothly between anchors (Gaussian weights, sigma in units). Zero anchors: places where quest zones, door locks and containers from the game data sit right on the render (north terminal, water plant, village, Icebreaker pier, hill houses, cliff compound, south coast). South-west anchors: the causeway (the game's claymores lie on its road, about 17 m north of the render's road) and the rebuilt lighthouse island (the Top Secret quest zone and a door lock sit about 8 m east of the render's walls).
